single.rationale: Hillman shows positive momentum with improving operating margins (2.7% in 2022 to 7.3% in 2025) and turning profitable, but faces significant headwinds from tariffs (~33% China exposure), flat revenue growth over three years (1.5% CAGR), high leverage ($647M net debt), and exposure to a weak housing market (30-year low in existing home sales). The stock trades at stretched multiples (46x P/E, 53x P/FCF) given the challenging macro environment and execution risks.

team.thesis: Hillman has executed a substantial margin expansion story, with operating income nearly tripling from $39.9M in 2022 to $114.0M in 2025 while revenue grew modestly from $1.5B to $1.6B, but this improvement is overshadowed by severe structural headwinds: two customers represent $674.3M of $1.6B in 2025 revenue creating extreme concentration risk that materialized with True Value's bankruptcy result
